caption: Fig. 1.2: Experimental results for the solubility of HCl gas in cyclohexane at 293 K. The slope of the line is the Henry's Law constant, K_H.
labels: Mole fraction of HCl in its solution in cyclohexane
note: Caption is printed over five justified lines; "K_H" is printed as an italic K with subscript H followed by a full stop. A faint diagonal page watermark (a circled c and the words "not to") crosses the plot area and is not a figure label.
